red_tests.failure_fingerprint: AssertionError: --skip-tests flag not registered in argparse

rationale: CI on main failed (run 35600839519) because the Run Project Code Reviewer step re-ran the entire pytest suite nested inside the reviewer, which intermittently hangs until the 1800s subprocess timeout. The --skip-tests flag lets ci.yml skip the redundant nested run because it already executed the full suite in a prior step.
